fixture_notice: Synthetic data only; evaluations are not real news.

evals.name: multi-topic supplied sources
evals.prompt: Summarize local transit and library developments for Linden residents in the past 48 hours using source-packet.md. No live browsing is available.
checks: Merge A/B/C as one event and one evidence chain.
Include D as approval for a future pilot, not all-library hours already changed.
Exclude F stale event, G unknown timing, H other region, I rumor.
Chat only; no forced categories or padded count.

evals.name: no live tools
evals.prompt: Give me today's photography industry news. No browsing and no supplied sources are available.
checks: Do not invent news from memory.
State limitation; offer supplied-source summary without requiring Tavily installation.

evals.name: ambiguous topic
checks: Ask one concise topic question; no assumed AI subject.

evals.name: optional HTML
evals.prompt: Turn the supplied briefing into HTML without refreshing it.
checks: Preserve coverage and research timestamp, facts, caveats and URLs.
No CDN, real-world sample claims, or unfilled placeholders.
Usable narrow layout and keyboard-accessible links.

evals.name: quiet day
evals.prompt: Using source-packet.md, cover Linden transit from 2026-10-05 11:00 to 12:00 UTC only.
checks: No widening, invented stories, or claim that no news exists anywhere.

evals.name: topic switch
evals.prompt: Using only the supplied sources, switch to the library pilot and explain what residents should know.
checks: State one branch, November start, four Saturdays, and supplied-source limits.

evals.name: no file creation
evals.prompt: Visualize the supplied digest, but file tools are unavailable.
checks: Offer standalone HTML source; no invented saved artifact link.
